recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit. It restores accepted FHIR-17447 guidance that was lost in a later page rewrite without reintroducing the malformed original markdown link or changing unrelated search behavior.
issue_request: FHIR-17447 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request asking the FHIR-core search page to make explicit that query responses cannot be subdivided into separate sub-Bundles and can include resources that are not hosted/readable through the responding server.
initial_application: The issue was applied by svn r14257 in git commit 5d9f0714c67b0b73079017756ca207f3d36411f9, which added two paragraphs to source/search.html. The 2022 search page rewrite in 36e9fd596f144835ac237e7f8ef619656091f29f6 removed those explicit paragraphs while reorganizing the Search Responses content.
additional_context: The original Zulip thread confirms both intended rules: no sub search result bundles and allowance for proper FHIR resources generated from data not available through read. source/fhir.ini actively includes Search=search.html, and no Confluence reference or later conflicting decision was found in the bounded search.
reconciliation: Updated source/search.html in the Search Responses section to state that servers MAY include resources unavailable through read/vread and that a search response SHALL be one result set in a single searchset Bundle, not nested searchset Bundles representing alternatives. The text also avoids over-forbidding Bundle resources by clarifying that a returned Bundle resource is an ordinary match or include entry in the same result set.
source_changes: source/search.html: Added Search Responses conformance text permitting resources unavailable through read/vread and disallowing nested searchset Bundles as alternative result sets.
